jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description:
Join our remote data platform group and build dependable services for teams across the company.

Responsibilities

  • Design batch and streaming pipelines using Python and SQL.
  • Improve data quality, monitoring, deployment automation, and operational support.
  • Partner with analysts and engineers on clear data contracts.

Requirements

You have experience delivering production data systems, reviewing technical designs, explaining trade-offs, and working effectively in a distributed team. Cloud and infrastructure-as-code experience would be useful.

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description: Lead a distributed product team and define its roadmap with customers.
